test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: There are eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, sitting around a rectangular table in such a way that four of them sit at four corners of the table while the other four sit in the middle of each of the four sides. All the eight persons face toward the centre. T sits third to the right of V, but T is not the immediate neighbour of U. R sits second to the right of Q. S sits second to the right of U. P sits third to the right Q. Who among the following is sitting 4th to the right of P?
solution: **Given:** There are eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, sitting around a rectangular table All the eight persons face toward the centre. 1) T sits third to the right of V, but T is not the immediate neighbour of U. 2) R sits second to the right of Q.
